items.q: What is a broadcast join in Spark?
items.a:
The small table is copied to every executor so the large table does not need to be shuffled.
Use it when one side comfortably fits in memory.

items.q: Why is data skew a problem in Spark?
items.a:
A few keys hold most rows, so one task runs far longer than the rest. Fix with AQE skew join,
salting, or broadcasting the smaller side.
